%description: Maps an item's in-game 'Item Type' label (from description_data) to a browse category name. Module:Entity emits [[Category:<value>]] when a label matches; unmapped labels get no item-type category. Names are sentence-case plural to match the type categories (e.g. 'Guns'). Sibling to types.json, one level finer (types.json keys the API type enum; this keys the freeform in-game label). Extend as new item types appear.
